# Sakai Enterprise Dashboard

> Administrative analytics, workspace metrics, and user management dashboard for the Sakai enterprise micro-frontend platform.

## Dashboard Navigation
- [Dashboard Overview](http://localhost:4000/): High-level KPIs, revenue charts, and sales activity.
- [User Management](http://localhost:4000/pages/users): Role-based access control and user CRUD operations.
- [UI Components](http://localhost:4000/uikit): Reusable PrimeNG UI kit and component library.

## Platform Micro-Frontends
- [Landing Page](http://localhost:4001/): Public SaaS portal, product features, and pricing.
- [Authentication](http://localhost:4002/login): Single sign-on portal and user registration.
